figurative_meaning_en: To extract or collect by force or coercion
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুর কাছ থেকে ঘাড় ভাঙা করে টাকা আদায় করেছে।
দোকানদাররা গ্রাহকের ঘাড় ভাঙা করে দাম বাড়িয়ে দেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He forced his friend to pay up by breaking his neck, figuratively speaking.
Shopkeepers often hike prices by breaking customers' necks through coercion.
note: The idiom implies extreme pressure, often in contexts of debt or obligation in Bengali society.
